race.description: Brundee Blooms Greenwell Point Cup Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: HEY JUDE (4) is the main danger if forgiven for a plain Newcastle run over 1300m, with her earlier Kembla Grange third and strong record at this track keeping her right in play. NIGHTS INFERNO (5) was an outside chance in betting when third at Cootamundra, beaten a length and a half after beginning only fairly and being steadied late. Proven enough at 1100m to threaten. GIRLS WEEKEND (2) resumes after five months and must rebound from a soft-ground Wyong failure, but her Canberra Acton BM60 win two starts back gives her a genuine place-to-winning profile if forward enough first-up. VEREEVA (8) improver on the quick backup when third here over this trip. Kept fresh and stays in the mix.
